title: Verify display manager service symlink
summary: Check if the generic 'display-manager.service' symlink points to your active display manager, which confirms it is correctly configured as the default.

steps.explain: Use the 'file' command to see which service the generic display-manager.service symlink points to.
steps.expect: Output shows a symbolic link to your display manager's service file, e.g., 'symbolic link to /usr/lib/systemd/system/sddm.service'.
